how_to_read: Layer 2 decision fields (dec.*) store the chosen option label. Look it up in "decisions" and apply its "sets" values.
Layer 4 advanced fields are optional. A filled advanced field overrides the value its decision set.
A decision option with empty "sets" (Strength: Custom) means the matching advanced fields become required.
Layer 3 program fields are read as-is. Checkboxes store /Yes or /Off. Philosophy and meta fields are not imported.
Import fails with the sheet name and question text if any required field is empty.
